_comment: Refresh schedule for Fremont by the Numbers. One entry per dataset in data/_catalog.json. 'typical_release' is when the publisher usually updates (verify before relying on a date). 'method': download = a direct file or API a script can fetch from an open-internet machine; page = read a web page; pdf = read a PDF report; dashboard = Power BI/other dashboard read by hand in a browser; manual = judgment or search needed. 'cadence' decides how often the site should re-check. Drafted Oct 25, 2026.

cadences.annual: Re-check once a year, around the publisher's release
cadences.static: Does not change until the publisher issues a new edition

zillow_market.note: Zillow requires clear attribution. City CSVs: ZHVI and ZORI (RegionID 11540). Sales measures lag one month.

zillow_history.note: Append the new month; earlier months can be revised, so re-write the full series.

redfin_market.note: Redfin's terms for republishing these figures are not confirmed; decide before launch whether to keep this dataset.

jobs_more.typical_release: city unemployment about 3-4 weeks after month end (EDD/BLS LAUS)
jobs_more.note: Only the unemployment-rate rows are monthly; the rest of the dataset is annual (ACS, LEHD, WARN).

homeless_monthly.note: Headline app-report count differs from the sum of rows (noted on the site).

vacancy.typical_release: Kidder Mathews quarterly reports, about 2-3 weeks after quarter end

food_cpi.typical_release: BLS San Francisco-area CPI is published every two months; the site uses each August
food_cpi.next_check: mid-Sep 2027 (or Oct/Nov 2026 if you want a newer month)
food_cpi.note: Decide whether to keep 'each August' or move to the latest release.

food_prices.typical_release: CPI changes follow food_cpi; MIT living-wage food budgets update each spring
food_prices.note: Restaurant and store counts are 2022 Economic Census (next census 2027).

health_access.typical_release: CMS Care Compare updates a few times a year; Leapfrog grades each spring and fall

leapfrog_grades.typical_release: Leapfrog Hospital Safety Grades, spring and fall

utilities.typical_release: PG&E and Ava rate changes usually Jan and Mar; internet prices change often

family_costs.typical_release: kidsdata.org child care (every few years); Ava/PG&E rates; ACWD water FY report

living_facts.typical_release: utility rates and tax rates change by fiscal year (July); BART ridership annual

dof_population.typical_release: Department of Finance E-1, about May 1
dof_population.note: Rates per 1,000 on the crime page use E-1 population.

census_profile.typical_release: ACS 5-year each December (2021-2025 expected Dec 2026); 1-year Oct 29, 2026
census_profile.note: data.census.gov table API works without a key from a browser; api.census.gov now needs a key.

people_more.typical_release: ACS 5-year December; County Business Patterns mid-year

rent_by_bedroom.typical_release: ACS 5-year (December); HUD Fair Market Rents each Oct 1 for the next fiscal year

business.typical_release: County Business Patterns, mid-year; CDTFA taxable sales

retail_mix.typical_release: Economic Census every 5 years (2022 edition now; next is 2027, published about 2029-30)

crime_oj.typical_release: CA DOJ OpenJustice Crimes and Clearances, July
crime_oj.note: Fremont 2025 is incomplete in the July 2026 release; re-check then.

police_staffing.typical_release: CA DOJ Law Enforcement Personnel, summer

hate_crimes.typical_release: CA DOJ Hate Crimes file, summer

police_facts.typical_release: FPD yearly summary, early in the year; community survey every few years

fire_incidents.typical_release: city dashboard; full-year totals in January
fire_incidents.note: The 2026 date range on the dashboard was unconfirmed; use full-year 2026 once the incident-summaries page posts it.

traffic_fatal.typical_release: city Traffic Safety page, early in the year

traffic_facts.typical_release: city and FPD pages; community survey

schools.typical_release: CAASPP results in the fall; CDE graduation data in the winter

school_list.typical_release: CAASPP (fall), DataQuest enrollment (winter), Ed-Data (winter), U.S. News (Aug)
school_list.note: DataQuest shows a CAPTCHA after a few requests; use Ed-Data instead and do not work around it.

high_schools.typical_release: U.S. News Best High Schools, August

city_rankings.typical_release: WalletHub lists publish on their own dates through the year; ParkScore each spring
city_rankings.note: Check each row's edition year and 'of N' count against the live ranking page.

employers.typical_release: City Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR), December
employers.note: Currently the FY2024 table via Wikipedia; refresh from the city's own ACFR.

city_facts.typical_release: adopted city budget, June; FUSD enrollment, fall
city_facts.next_check: Jul 2026 adopted budget document (not found online as of Oct 2026)

civic_facts.typical_release: SOS Report of Registration (several per election cycle); ROV canvass after each election

housing_production.typical_release: city Housing Element Annual Progress Report, Feb-Mar

rhna_by_income.typical_release: city Housing Element Annual Progress Report, Feb-Mar

ev_zip.typical_release: CA DMV vehicle fuel type by ZIP, early each year

ghg_sector.typical_release: new city emissions inventory (last inventory year 2018)
ghg_sector.next_check: when the city posts a new inventory

parks_summary.typical_release: city park pages, TPL ParkScore in spring

city_parks.typical_release: city Open Data Hub parks layer (changes rarely)

events.typical_release: event dates and prices change each season

bart_history.typical_release: BART fiscal year ends June; DataSF daily exits

homeless_pit.typical_release: Alameda County point-in-time count, every two years (2026 shown)

startups.typical_release: no schedule; Crunchbase and VCBacked counts drift

startup_rounds.typical_release: no schedule; new funding rounds and IPOs
